reviews.title: Complicated and complex
reviews.text: Look, I understand technology comes with new barriers. This system is Beyond. It's time before there is definitely no guidance other than the fact that it glitches a lot and you cannot sign into your account and it just keeps loading and loading and loading. If this is how it starts out, I can only imagine what it feels like actually using the app I canceled my subscription and I will be moving forward with another app

reviews.title: Kids Can Work Around Time Restrictions
reviews.text: It was great at first but kids can use GPT to easily work around the time restrictions by changing the time on their phone in settings.  OurPact provides no way to address this.

reviews.text: This app did not work right from day 1. It was the biggest waste of money. To get it on your kids phone and yours is ridiculous. You finally install it and it doesn’t work! One year later, it still has my son’s phone locked up and I cannot get it off. Worst puchase of my life.

The schedule and blocking doesn’t work my teenager’s phone is always unblocked even with the schedule activated. Again very useless app, don’t waste your time.

reviews.title: Poor install process
reviews.text:
The app requires you to connect the child’s phone to a computer. No problem with that. But afterwards several apps were deleted (not inaccessible, deleted), wallpapers changed, etc. 

That either should not happen, or should be made explicit in the instructions. 

It was not clear how to use the child’s app after that (requires pushing a start/stop button even to access allowed apps and sites). It was much too intrusive.

reviews.title: App is pretty terrible.
reviews.text: App doesn’t work easily.  WAYYY too many bugs.  Way too complicated.  Glitches everywhere.  My son deleted the app on his end.  Nothing works easily or clearly.  Complete waste of money unless you’re willing to invest a huge amount of time monitoring and figuring out this app.  I need to find another parental control blocker for my son’s iPad.

reviews.title: Glitches Cost Us Hundreds
reviews.text:
OurPact’s basic screen‑time management works fine, but the app has some serious reliability issues. Several of my child’s app settings repeatedly revert to “Always Allow,” and the “Disable In‑App Purchases” feature randomly turns itself off. After 10 months of using this app, these glitches have cost our family nearly $500 in in‑app purchases I believed were blocked.

I reached out to the developer multiple times, but instead of troubleshooting, they insisted my child “must” have my password or access to my devices and was overriding the settings. That simply isn’t the case, and it was frustrating to have the blame shifted back onto us rather than the app’s functionality being addressed.

At this point, I can’t recommend OurPact. Don’t waste your time or money. We’re switching to Bark, hoping for a more reliable and accountable solution.

reviews.title: Frustrated
reviews.text: Been a user for a long time, my teen has access to removing management therefore they are able to see all apps for usage. Outpact didn’t inform me until I inquired why my teen gets access to all apps. Can’t give me ETA I’m done bye Ourpact!

reviews.title: Horrible App Organjzer
reviews.text: Works fine only problem is every time the phone gets locked the apps get reorganized which makes it really frustrating. I understand there is an app organizer available however  you cannot organize any shortcuts or widgets which is really annoying. Please update this problem, otherwise the app would be lovely

reviews.title: Only works with a computer set up
reviews.text: Waste of time as you need to set it up with a computer (like the old iTunes days 🙄)

reviews.title: Problems removing app.
reviews.text: I am a parent that used OurPact for several years. Customer service has been absolutely awful when trying to remove the app and supervision from the phone. We’ve emailed numerous times asking for help with a technical issue while trying to remove the supervision profile and keep getting the same AI generated response. This is insanely frustrating.

reviews.title: App Completely Nonfunctional
reviews.text: I reached out to support about tamperproofing, the feature that prevents this app from just being uninstalled by anyone, being non functional. It has been two months and they are still “working on it”. This renders the app completely useless. I’m not sure what the developers are doing over there but it’s bewildering that a bug that makes the app completely useless has not been fixed in over two months.

reviews.title: No Tamperproof with IOS 26
reviews.text: Wanted to give this a chance, but without tamper proof working; what’s the point.

reviews.title: Nuked my son’s phone
reviews.text: Don’t install this on your kid’s phone unless you want it to take over everything. Completely blew away wallpapers, app groupings, contact images, etc. Tried to immediately reinstall every app that’s ever been on his phone. Then when I tried to use the one feature I wanted this app for, the random screenshots to keep him honest, found out you have to pay a monthly subscription to use any of the features that are worth anything.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: This app was very difficult to install using the connect app, once installed it was buggy. Often the play/pause on my child’s device didn’t work. You can’t set limits per app like you can with the iOS family app. It totally blocked “class charts” which my child’s school uses, even though both the app and the website were allowed. It also messed with her widgets and layout. She found it very frustrating.

reviews.title: Not for us
reviews.text: The app was so clunky, and requiring our child to have to press play to broadcast their activity inside their junior app was a non starter.  It just didn’t do what we hoped it would do, maybe it’s an iOS thing, but it just doesn’t work properly.  App removed and will never be revisited.

reviews.title: PARENTS BEWARE OF THIS APP
reviews.text: I’m beyond upset of this app. I’ve been trying to get rid of them managing my son’s account forever. I messaged their customer service even their IG account to get the resolution but they continue to ignore me and decides to hosrage my son’s phone. Beware before signing up because even Apple won't be able to help you since OurPact is controlling the phone. Trust me I tried all different avenues and still nothing. Stay away from this app!!!!

reviews.title: Not as easy to use. Download years old apps no longer used and error on most used apps.
reviews.text:
How can I get a refund for my subscription or a prorated amount for the annual subscription I paid for? Installing and pairing OurPact with my phone caused errors on my phone, programs that have been deleted for several years started to be downloaded again, apps that were working fine now have errors or missing login, etc. This is not what I expected or the ease of use indicated on the app. I do not see myself using this moving forward and feel $99 for the year for an app that I will not be using is a little steep. Thank you. 

Cheers
